From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Subject: Procurement readiness & next steps — AcmeCloud

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for taking time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps on procurement/readiness and the commercial path so we keep things moving: 

Summary of ask / context:
- AcmeCloud is evaluating Redwood for low-latency inference across customer-facing workflows (demo -> pilot -> production).
- Primary procurement questions: whether you’ll go through a PO/paper process for production or use card for initial POC, and whether you want to transact via AWS Marketplace.

Proposed commercial paths (we can support either):
1) PO / MSA -> preferred for production (finance issues a PO once legal & security sign-off complete).
2) Card for initial pilot (quick path to get started; finance can later convert to PO).
3) Marketplace (AWS) — we can onboard, but that timing depends on your procurement team and marketplace setup.

Procurement milestones (high-level timeline assumptions):
- Legal review (MSA redlines returned): ~1 week after we share MSA / redlines come back (owner: Acme legal, point: Marcus will triage redlines).
- Security review (credentialing / SOC2 questionnaire + evidence): ~7-10 business days once questionnaire submitted (owner: Acme security; we can provide SOC2 and a short security packet).
- Finance review & PO issuance: 3-5 business days after final approvals (owner: Acme finance).

Attached I’m sending a draft mutual action plan (MPA v1.1), a brief SOW, and a procurement timeline spreadsheet to use for your internal tracking.

Next steps / asks:
- Can you confirm whether AcmeCloud will aim for PO for production or prefer card conversion?
- Who should we add to the MPA for legal and security reviewers (name + email)?
- If you want to run the pilot on card, we can enable that immediately once you say so.

I’ll loop Marcus (our legal lead) and Camila (sales ops) to help with MSA redlines, DocuSign, and PO routing.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick follow-up with your procurement team if helpful.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0128

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. Helpful. A few notes from procurement/security/finance side: 

Procurement path:
- For production we will need a PO and an MSA/PO process. Finance typically requires a PO for any long-running production contracts.
- For an initial POC/pilot (<= 90 days, low spend) we can pay on corporate card to speed things up; finance will expect a path to convert to PO for production.
- Marketplace: we are interested in AWS Marketplace for later-stage procurement, but that has additional onboarding friction on our side. Not a blocker, but not preferred for Phase 1.

Timeline expectations (internal):
- Legal review: expect ~2 weeks for initial review + potential negotiation on standard redlines (depends on scope).
- Security/compliance: will need your SOC2 summary and answers to our questionnaire; anticipate 7–10 business days after submission.
- Finance/PO issuance: once legal + security sign off, PO issuance takes ~3–7 business days depending on approvals.

Action items for Redwood:
- Please share the MSA and any standard redline guidance.
- We’ll need your SOC2 summary + a stash of artifacts (encryption, retention, data flow diagram) — can you point me to those or attach?
- Please put Marcus (legal) and your ops lead on copy so procurement can coordinate directly.

I’m copying Priya (procurement lead) and our procurement inbox. I’ll review the materials and get back with an internal timeline by EOD Wednesday.

Thanks,
Jordan Smith
Head of Procurement | AcmeCloud
jordan.smith@acmecloud.com

Appreciate the clarity, Jordan — that aligns with what I expected. A couple concrete notes and a proposed scoped timeline so procurement can slot things into calendar: 

What Redwood will provide immediately:
- MSA + SOW (attached draft) — Marcus will handle legal triage on any redlines.
- SOC2 summary and security packet (we include the checklist + artifact links); I’ve attached the short security one-pager and we can send the full questionnaire answers once you share your template.
- Procurement timeline spreadsheet (attached) with milestone dates filled in as placeholders.

Proposed mutually-agreed milestones (we can refine on your timeline):
- Day 0: Redwood shares MSA, SOW, SOC2 summary, and procurement timeline (today).
- Day 1–7: Acme legal review MSA and return initial redlines (target: Jul 6). Marcus will review redlines and propose responses within 2 business days of receipt.
- Day 3–14: Security questionnaire exchange and evidence sharing (target complete by Jul 15).
- Day 15–20: Finance issues PO (target window Jul 16–Jul 21) — assumes legal/security sign-off.

Owners / point people:
- Redwood legal: Marcus Lin (marcus.lin@redwood.com) — will triage MSA redlines.
- Redwood ops / PO routing: Camila Reyes (camila@redwood.com) — will create DocuSign envelope and support PO attachments.
- Redwood CS / onboarding: Rachel Kim (rachel.kim@redwood.com) — will prepare kickoff materials for pilot.

If Acme wants a card-based POC to get started while legal completes review, we can enable that the same week — let me know and I’ll send a short payment link and invoice flow.

DocuSign / next steps:
- I’ve created an initial DocuSign envelope for the MSA + SOW and can add Priya and your procurement inbox as signers once you confirm the preferred commercial path.
- For tracking, here’s our HubSpot deal for reference: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567

Let me know who from your legal/security/finance teams I should include on the MPA and I’ll update the doc and send the DocuSign link.

Best,
Marissa
